text:
tara: Noticing an overcount for invoices covering 2026-06-10T22:58Z -> 2026-06-10T23:10Z. ~60 customers show higher token usage. Appears to be a 2-min overlap from the aggregator window boundary. Holding invoice runs, need owners for fix + customer remediation.
ben: quick triage: aggregator finished a flush and then retried the last batch with identical sequence numbers; consumer accepted both because checkpoint used batch_timestamp not seq. root cause = boundary retry + weak checkpointing.
sofia: I'll build a safe backfill that computes net deltas (dedupe by event_seq + event_id). ETA 5h for dry-run. Will push artifacts to FIN-5301.
billing-bot: Created FIN-5301: "Aggregator boundary overlap -> invoice overcount remediation" (owners: sofia, tara, lee). Severity: High. Linked to INC-2026-0610.
lee: containment: paused aggregator finalizer at 23:07Z and added a temporary guard to drop events with duplicate (event_id, seq). also placed a soft freeze on invoicing for the affected window.
tara: Proposed action list (please ack): 1) Fix checkpoint logic + canary (owner: ben) due: 2026-06-11T18:00Z. 2) Dry-run backfill & verify (owner: sofia) due: 2026-06-11T04:00Z. 3) Generate CSV for finance (owner: sofia -> tara) due: 2026-06-11T06:00Z. 4) Apply provisional credits for positive net_delta (owner: tara) due: 2026-06-11T09:00Z. 5) Issue corrected invoices where net_delta > $50 (owner: billing ops) due: 2026-06-12T12:00Z. 6) Postmortem + recurrence checklist (owner: tara) due: 2026-06-15.
ben: I'll change checkpoint to (partition, last_seq) durable commit and add idempotency test for boundary retries. Canary schedule: eu-west-1 2026-06-11T17:00Z.
sofia: dry-run command: ```./netdelta --start 2026-06-10T22:58Z --end 2026-06-10T23:10Z --dedupe-seq --dry-run --out dryrun-0610.log``` staging run shows 59 affected customers. will upload CSV: /artifacts/fin5301/dryrun.csv when done.
lee: monitoring: new alert rule `aggregator.overlap_rate > 0.5% for 5m` and `invoicing.freeze_active == true` to prevent accidental billing.
tara: comms plan: short email + support FAQ. tara will own customer messaging; tara -> billing ops will label invoices as "provisionally adjusted" until final reconciliation.
billing-bot: FIN-5301 updated: artifact added by sofia.
sofia: QA: please run regression sim that replays boundary retry and verifies dedupe. tagging qa-metering.
tara: owners acknowledged. I'll own the postmortem, recurrence playbook, and follow-ups. please update FIN-5301 with progress. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
